column1: # ENCODE EP300 ChIP-seq + ATAC-seq for the six biosamples added for p300_panel_14, selected 2026-10-20.
# Same columns as p300_tissue_manifest.tsv plus donor and read_length (bp + SE/PE; review F23).
# Conventions as there: unfiltered ChIP BAM (filtered locally by 0.45), filtered ATAC BAM, the most
# recent reprocessing of each replicate, IDR thresholded peaks (ENCODE's optimal set).
# SK-N-SH: ENCODE has NO released untreated SK-N-SH ATAC; the only released one (ENCSR587TRP) is
#   treated with 6 uM all-trans retinoic acid for 48 h. The EP300 is taken from the RA-treated
#   ChIP (ENCSR000BMA, HAIB) so target and input share one condition, hence the name SK-N-SH_RA.
#   Untreated EP300 exists (ENCSR000EHV Snyder 36 bp, 35,757 IDR peaks; ENCSR000BUA HAIB 50 bp)
#   if the untreated-target/RA-input pairing is preferred.
# Donor matching (ENTEx donors): sigmoid colon and tibial nerve are donor-matched. Not possible
#   for esophagus muscularis mucosa (EP300 only ENCDO845WKR, ATAC only ENCDO451RUA),
#   gastroesophageal sphincter (EP300 ENCDO451RUA/ENCDO845WKR, ATAC ENCDO793LXB/ENCDO271OUW) or
#   upper lobe of left lung (ATAC only from non-ENTEx donors ENCDO186XRB/ENCDO520EJG). There the
#   EP300 with more IDR peaks and the compliant/larger ATAC were taken: GES EP300 ENCSR551MLB
#   (12,968 peaks vs 1,831), GES ATAC ENCSR670REK; lung EP300 ENCSR000MMZ (26,266 peaks), lung
#   ATAC ENCSR895SEG (137,602 peaks; NOT_COMPLIANT low FRiP, as is the alternative ENCSR242QRV).
#   Sigmoid colon: ENCDO845WKR, the transverse colon donor.
